CRM · CASE STUDY

The changing face of CRM

What a CRM competes on once anyone can rebuild the workflow in a weekend.

The problem

If the workflow part of a CRM is now easy to replicate, what is left to compete on?

Thought process

Opening the CRM to every agent risks turning it into a dumb pipe. The value has to move to context, reach and outcomes that customers can’t configure themselves.

The solution

Treat MCP as table stakes so customers can drive the CRM from their own agents, then go beyond the named lead: help with acquisition before a contact exists, bring industry intelligence and reach that a self-built workflow can’t, and stay the source of record for outcomes.
